data.name: City View Tour
data.headline: 10AM • 2PM • 2.5-3 Hours • Our Flagship Tour!
data.description:
![Description of image](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/CDHeqVkITWeQUl0QvhtL)


The City View Tour is our flagship tour, covering most of the City of Boston. This tour will take you through 6 different neighborhoods, and countless historical and cultural sites throughout the city.


We are currently requiring advance bookings. Please reserve you tour spot by 6pm the day prior to your preferred tour date.


From the bustling streets of downtown, to the serene bike paths on the Charles River, this tour truly brings you the Best of Boston by Bicycle!

##Tour Times
- **Daily: 10am & 2pm**

##Duration
- **2.5 - 3 hours long**
-  **10-12 miles**
data.highlights:
- The North End - Boston's Italian and oldest residential neighborhood, with views of Charlestown
- The Charles River Esplanade, with views of Cambridge and MIT
- Boston University Campus and Kenmore Square
- Historic Fenway Park
- The Christian Science Center
- Copley Square, home of the John Hancock Building and the finish line of the Boston Marathon
- The beautiful brownstones in Back Bay and the South End
- Boston Common
- The Rose Kennedy Greenway – Boston’s newest public park
- The Long Wharf, with views of South and East Boston

data.cancellation_notes:
**IMPORTANT: PLEASE READ - By booking, you are agreeing to accept these terms**

Within two weeks of your reserved event, tickets are NON-REFUNDABLE, but may be rescheduled for a $25 fee per ticket based on availability. Customers may cancel penalty-free up to 48 hours after booking, unless the event is within 14 days. We offer 50% refunds for cancellations made more than 14 days prior to the event. We cannot refund cancellations made within 14 days of an event because your space must be reserved. 

Rescheduling requests are subject to availability and are processed at the sole discretion of the employee making the transaction. Rescheduling requests received within 14 days of the event are subject to a fee of $25 per ticket to reschedule. Reservations may be rescheduled only once.

Failure to arrive 30 minutes before your tour’s departure time will result in your space on tour being given away. You will not receive a refund or credit for your tour. Late arrivals will not be caught up to the tour.

Our tours run rain or shine. In some circumstances, tours may be cancelled up to an hour before the start time of the event. The decision to cancel the tour is up to the sole discretion of Urban AdvenTours. If we cancel the event, ticket-holders may choose to reschedule tickets (subject to availability), to receive credit for a future event, or to receive a full refund.

Massachusetts law requires children to be at least 12 months of age while riding along on a bicycle. Children under the age of 12 months will not be allowed on rentals or tours. All children ages 16 and under are required to wear a helmet, and all guests are required to wear a helmet when participating on a UA-guided bike tour.
data.booking_notes:
## Meeting Location and Arrival Time

**Please arrive 30 minutes before your tour start time**  
(9:30 am for 10:00 am tours | 1:30 pm for 2:00 pm tours)  
This allows time for check-in, paperwork, and bike fitting.  
**Late arrivals cannot be caught up, refunded, or rescheduled.**

- The waiver is linked above in this confirmation email. All participants must complete it before arrival.
- Urban AdvenTours is located at **103 Atlantic Ave**, Boston (North End), across from Christopher Columbus Park and near the New England Aquarium and Faneuil Hall.
- Closest subway stops: **Aquarium (Blue Line)** and **Haymarket (Orange/Green Lines)**.
- Boston can be difficult to navigate if you are unfamiliar with the area. Please plan your route ahead of time and allow extra travel time.
- Nearby parking options include **Lewis Wharf Parking Lot** and **North End Parking Garage**.

---

## What to Expect When You Arrive

Want to know exactly what check-in looks like?  
Watch this quick walkthrough showing where to go and how we get you ready to ride.

 **[▶ Watch the Check-In Walkthrough](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DLXvTPbR1FY/?utm_source=ig_web_copy_link&igsh=MzRlODBiNWFlZA==)**

---

## What to Bring

- Water bottle (free refills available at the shop)
- Sunscreen and sunglasses in warm weather
- Optional snack or sports drink
- Camera if desired

Large bags, luggage, and bulky jackets may be left at the shop during the tour.

---

## What to Wear

- Comfortable, weather-appropriate clothing
- Sneakers or closed-toe shoes with good tread
- Layers for cooler temperatures or rain

Please do not wear:

- Skirts or dress clothes
- High heels or dress shoes
- Large purses
- Loose clothing that could get caught in the bike chain

If you need additional gear, our shop carries cycling apparel and accessories. Arrive early if you’d like to browse.

---

## Tour Guidelines

- Cell phone use while riding is prohibited for safety reasons.
- Limited storage is available. Please bring only what you need.
- Water bottles and sports drinks are available for purchase at the shop.
- Any directions or maps provided are general guides. You are responsible for arriving on time using your own navigation.

**Tipping your guide at the conclusion of the tour is customary and appreciated.**

---

## Getting to Urban AdvenTours

**103 Atlantic Ave, Boston (North End)**  
Across from Christopher Columbus Park, near the New England Aquarium and Faneuil Hall.  
**Closest subway stop:** Aquarium Station (Blue Line)

Please plan your route in advance.  
We are not able to provide turn-by-turn directions over the phone.

---

### Public Transit (Strongly Recommended)

Boston traffic and parking can be difficult. Public transit is usually the easiest option.

**Walking distance:**

- 15 minutes from North Station
- 25 minutes from South Station

**Nearby subway stops:**

- Aquarium (Blue Line) — closest
- Haymarket (Green and Orange Lines)
- State Street (Orange and Blue Lines)
- Government Center (Green and Blue Lines)
- Park Street (Green and Red Lines)

Plan your trip: https://www.mbta.com

---

### Parking

There is **no street parking** at our location.

Nearby garages:

- Standard Parking — 260 Commercial St | (617) 367-1681
- Government Center Garage — 50 New Sudbury St | (617) 227-0385

---

### Walking Directions from Major Subway Stops

**From Aquarium (Blue Line):**  
Walk north on Atlantic Ave past Columbus Park.  
Turn right on Atlantic Ave.

**From Haymarket (Green/Orange):**  
Walk south on Surface Rd.  
Turn left on Mercantile St and cross the Greenway.  
Continue onto Atlantic Ave.

**From State Street (Orange/Blue):**  
Walk east toward the water.  
Cross the Greenway and turn left.  
Walk past Columbus Park.  
Turn right on Atlantic Ave.

**From Government Center (Green/Blue):**  
Walk through City Hall Plaza.  
Cross Congress St.  
Walk through Faneuil Hall/Quincy Market.  
Cross the Greenway and turn left.  
Turn right on Atlantic Ave.

data.restrictions:
- Advance reservations are currently **required**.
- This tour is **not** recommended for those who are uncomfortable cycling on city streets. We welcome families with children who are comfortable cyclists and at least 10 years old. Younger riders and those less comfortable on two wheels are encouraged to take our Tour de Boston. We do not allow tandem bikes, burley trailers, or trail-a-bikes on this tour. The tour is roughly 25% on bike paths and 75% city-riding.
